title: Picture preparation measures cold surface waits and shares exact concurrent downloads
steps: Exercise real picture preparation with a virtual five-minute success and timeout, then concurrent and repeated surface reads.
expect: The entire surface wait is included in picture timing.code for success and failure.
Exact concurrent measurement inputs share one download; different identities stay independent.
Verified warm cache reuse avoids fetching; failed download remains unknown and retries later.

Unknown or missing template overlay measurement stays unknown in looker context, with strict raw-picture text and independent subject checks; verified absent and covering overlays keep their existing behavior.
fence: Keep contract hash validation, unknown overlay fallback and normal retry; never infer overlays from missing evidence.

tests: a five-minute cold surface fetch is included in picture preparation code time
a five-minute cold surface failure is included in picture preparation code time
an unknown template overlay stays unknown while raw text and subject checks remain strict
